description:
Get details of a single forum post (thread).

Args:
  - post_id (string): Forum post (thread) ID
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  The forum post details including tags, status, and message count

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

name: discord_get_forum_post
title: Get Discord Forum Post
